name: Touhou Chronicles: Tales of the Two Immortals
summary:
An epic chronicle beyond the borders of Gensokyo — a dazzling festival on a new stage!
With the destruction of Gensokyo as its central theme, the immortal Hourai dwellers rise to brilliance in a brand-new world, embarking on an eternal journey to find their long-lost companions!

All main characters from the official Touhou series — along with some “forgotten” faces from the past — make a return, ready to shine once more in this new realm!

What kind of adventures await the girls from Gensokyo beyond the fantasy world they once knew?
What new bonds will guide their futures in this unfamiliar land?

With over 20 playable characters, each featuring unique skills and personalities, you can form the ultimate dream team — one that’s perfectly tailored to your playstyle!

Awaken hidden potential!
Even the same character can evolve in countless ways, creating endless build possibilities and strategies.

Coordinate with your allies through the support combat system, and face off against fierce, tactical foes who will push your team to the limit!

A massive story with over 1 million words, 10 different endings, and deep character arcs that will reveal untold emotional journeys in this unfamiliar world.

Side stories are packed with detail and warmth, shedding new light on the inner worlds of the characters you thought you knew.

With New Game+ and progression carryover, every playthrough makes you stronger.
Whether you aim for the “Level 1 Challenge Run” or “Ultimate Swordmaster Route,” the game offers endless fun and replayability.

Difficulty settings are friendly and flexible — newcomers and veterans alike can enjoy the full experience. Even on easy mode, you’ll get a satisfying, complete ending.

A variety of mini-games, rich and meaningful side quests, and clever puzzles will constantly challenge your curiosity and passion!

Love collecting? The achievement and title system is made for you.
You can also link save data and character cards with your friends for co-op-style shared progress and support battles!

Earn high scores through title achievements — your total score becomes a badge of honor!

A grand conspiracy lies hidden in the threads of fate...
Only your unwavering determination can break Gensokyo free from the cycle of destruction!

All the fun — you’ll only understand once you try.
The longer you play, the deeper the experience becomes. Even after 100+ hours, you’ll still be discovering new rewards.

So come on — step into the fantasy chronicle’s time-space!
In this game world, discover the true charm of RPGs. This experience is one you deserve.
